description:
At Apple, we believe excellent ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products of the highest quality, creating unique experiences for our customers. We believe that when you bring passion and dedication to your job, there's no telling what you can accomplish! The people here at Apple don't just build products — they craft the kind of wonder that has revolutionized entire industries.

The Graphics, Games & Machine Learning team is looking for a self-motivated Test Engineer with expertise in both test strategy and automation development to help shape our next-generation products. This role requires an energetic individual with strong communication, organizational, and technical skills who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Description
The Graphics, Games & Machine Learning Test Engineering organization is seeking an experienced, self-motivated Test Engineer with a genuine passion for making the graphics and GPU experience on our products the best it can be. You will work with emerging GPU technologies at Apple, ensuring that we successfully deliver them to our customers at the industry-leading bar we have established.

In this role, you will wear multiple hats: driving comprehensive test strategies, developing robust automation frameworks, and building tools to support new hardware and software features.

Quality Leadership: Drive effective QA conversations with cross-functional teams to develop comprehensive test plans and test cases for GPU driver and Metal testing. Champion quality and engineering excellence throughout the development lifecycle.
Strategic Testing: Design and execute pre-submission testing for GPU drivers, ensuring critical issues are identified and resolved before integration. Develop test strategies that balance exploratory testing with high-value automated coverage.
Innovation in Testing: Be proactive in developing AI-enabled testing methodologies and novel approaches to validate the software components that comprise the GPU driver stack. Think creatively about expanding test coverage and automation effectiveness.
Automation Development: Build, maintain, and enhance scalable, reliable automation frameworks and tooling. Develop sophisticated test automation suites to validate both cutting-edge hardware and software capabilities.

As a successful candidate, you possess a strong aptitude for learning new technologies, excellent interpersonal and communication skills, and the drive to manage complex technical projects. You are equally comfortable discussing high-level test strategy with engineering stakeholders as you are writing code to automate intricate test scenarios. Strong collaborative skills and the ability to thrive under pressure are essential to succeed in this role.

Responsibilities
Drive QA strategy and develop comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test coverage analysis for GPU driver and Metal technologies.
Perform critical pre-submission testing and validation of GPU drivers.
Design and implement test automation frameworks and tools to support both manual and automated testing workflows.
Develop AI-enabled testing methodologies to improve test efficiency, triage, and coverage.
Build and maintain QA infrastructure, including CI/CD integration for automated test execution.
Conduct exploratory testing to identify edge cases and regressions that automated suites may miss.
Collaborate closely with hardware and software engineering teams to understand new features and develop appropriate test strategies.
Communicate test results, quality metrics, and release risks clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Mentor team members on testing best practices, triage methodologies, and automation techniques.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of QA processes, tools, and validation pipelines.

Minimum qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
Proven experience in both manual QA methodology and test automation development.
Strong track record of developing test plans, test cases, and test strategies for complex software systems.
Demonstrated software development ability with a focus on tools and test automation.
Proficiency with Unix-based operating systems (e.g., macOS, Linux) and command-line interface (CLI) tools.
Proficiency in Python; experience with Swift is a plus.
Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.
Solid understanding of fundamental data structures, algorithms, and software design principles.
Familiarity with AI/ML techniques and their practical application to software testing.
Familiarity with the complete software development lifecycle (SDLC), including requirements, design, development, testing, and deployment.
Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git).

Preferred qualifications
Experience with GPU technologies, graphics APIs (Metal, Vulkan, DirectX), or GPU driver development/testing.
Proven experience developing and maintaining QA infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and automation harnesses.
Experience with C/C++ programming and low-level software fundamentals.
Experience with white-box testing methodologies and code coverage analysis.
Experience with system-level profiling, debugging, and performance analysis tools (e.g., macOS Instruments, lldb).
Solid understanding of computer architecture and low-level hardware/software interactions.
Demonstrated background in designing and developing custom test tools and frameworks from the ground up.
